source_observations: Literal-bound support compiles exact reviewed bytes before project helper use. Three code/profile/support paths then bind regular working bytes to exact declared Git blobs.
Only official pinned archives and complete manifest.in file lists supply the installed prefix. Unknown paths, files, directories, modes, links, archive bytes and conflicting merges are refused.
Every official std/runtime file is retained. Unexecuted installer source and license bytes remain data, with a complete preserved-input check.
Every six-tool version probe uses a checked exact path and hash, a waited owned child and group cleanup. Complete prefix and source/input bytes are checked after the probes.
The consumer checks exact profile, full installed/preserved inventory, source binding record, version command arguments, log hashes, exit codes, waits and cleanup.
The job uses isolated Python -I -S -B on GitHub Ubuntu22.04, retains all failure evidence, and grants no product/runtime acceptance.
local_execution: source AST, publisher archive member reads/hashes, and Git metadata only; no project/helper imports, tests, tools, builds or services
